title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Civic Center on 1982-09-11

ai_review.summary: Excellent Seamons matrix captures a fiery 1982 show with standout performances of Scarlet Fire, Terrapin Station, Dupree's Diamond Blues and Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp, rich matrix mix that balances soundboard clarity with just the right amount of audience ambience. The concert itself is described as one of the best of an underrated 1982 year, featuring tight, well‑played versions of fan favorites such as Scarlet Fire, Terrapin Station, Dupree's Diamond Blues and Stella Blue.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are strongly positive about both the performance and the matrix recording; show quality and recording quality each rate near excellent, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp soundboard foundation with rich audience blend; praised for clarity, balance and no noted dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Well‑played throughout with personal favorites highlighted; the mix of songs flows smoothly and maintains high energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals and guitar noted as excellent on the soundboard.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards stand out in the mix.
